--a son of Bheda;
1: वा. ९९. १९६.
His daughters married by बाह्यक.
2: Ib. ९६. 3.
(II)--a son of कालनर(la) and father of Jana- mejaya; king vanquished by कृष्ण. भा. IX. २

(III)--a son of देवमीढ and मारिषा; wife राष्ट्रपाली and father of वृष and other sons;
1: भा. IX. २४. २९ and ४२.
went to Sya- मन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse.
2: Ib. X. ८२. १३ and २४.
(V)--a son of प्रतिपक्ष and father of Jaya. Br. III. ६८. 8.
(VII)--a son of शूर and भोजा; father of Dhanu and Vajra. Br. III. ७१. १४९, १९३. M. ४६. 3.
(VIII)--a son of कालानल and father of Puran- jaya. Br. III. ७४. १४; Vi. IV. १
(IX)--father of two daughters who became queens of भजमान. M. ४४. ४९. [page३-688+ २६]
(XI)--the son of धूम्राक्ष and the father of Sahadeva. वा. ८६. १९. Vi.

. ३५; IX. २४. ६३.
enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus. Took part in the festivities con- nected with the marriage of रुक्मिणी and कृष्ण;
2: Ib. X. [५० (v) 3]; ५४. ५८.
welcomed कृष्ण, followed Sahadeva in his conquest of southern coun- tries; took part in युधिष्ठिर's राजसूय; rose against शिसु- पाल.
3: Ib. X. ७१. २९; ७२. १३; ७४. ४१; ७५. १२.
